name: gestao-ativos-ti
description: Gestão de Ativos de TI — web (PWA) e app Android

scripts.serve: npm run vendor && npx --yes http-server www -p 8080 -c-1
scripts.android:add: npm run vendor && npx cap add android
scripts.android:sync: npm run vendor && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
